memories.title: The bug that would not go away
memories.text: Three hours stuck on an error in my @for. In the end I only had to restart ng serve.

memories.title: Rainy Sunday at home
memories.text: Tea, a blanket and a book. The rain did not stop all day and I did not mind at all.

memories.title: First day of the course
memories.text: I nearly turned back at the door. Then someone sat next to me and we became friends.

memories.title: The last day of summer
memories.text: Our last swim of the year. The water was cold and the sun was already low.
